title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Borrower Evidence Review Standard and Cancellation on Confirmed Coverage
content:
**Acceptance standard.** For the **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs**, borrower evidence is acceptable only when it shows a flood policy — an NFIP policy, or a private policy carrying the private flood compliance aid statement or otherwise accepted in writing by the lender — on the same building, with a building limit at least the required amount, in force on the date reviewed, and naming the lender as mortgagee (required on every tier). Evidence that fails any of these leaves the certificate in force.

| Evidence shows… | Acceptable? |
|---|---|
| An NFIP policy, or a qualifying private policy, on the same building, building limit at least the required amount, in force on the review date, lender named as mortgagee | Yes |
| Any one of those elements missing (for example, a different building, a building limit below the required amount, not in force on the review date, or no mortgagee clause naming the lender) | No — the certificate stays in force |

**Cancellation for confirmed borrower coverage.** On acceptable evidence the certificate is cancelled for confirmed borrower coverage, and the cancellation and its credit are processed no later than 30 calendar days (the overlap refund period) after the evidence is received, counted by adding the days to the received date on the calendar with the last day qualifying. The received date on the evidence entry is the starting point. The credit is booked to the program account as a premium credit linked to the cancellation entry.

| Processing day, counted on the calendar from the received date | Within the deadline? |
|---|---|
| Any day up to and including the 30th day after the received date | Yes |
| The 31st day or later | No |

**Effective date and credit.** When the borrower's policy was in force on the certificate's start date (a flat cancellation applies on every tier), the cancellation is a flat cancellation effective on that start date and the whole certificate premium is credited; otherwise it is a pro rata cancellation effective on the borrower policy's effective date and the credit is the annual premium multiplied by the days from that date to the certificate expiration date divided by the days in the certificate term, rounded to the cent. **This sentence is no longer in force for the overlap credit on the certificate named on the acceptable borrower evidence most recently received on the program; a credit on any other evidence keeps this treatment.**

**Further conditions.** This overlap credit is due even when a claim was paid on the certificate. The lender must refund to the borrower any premium it charged for the overlap period.

superseded_clauses: When flat_cancel_when_evidence_covers_inception is true and the borrower's policy was in force on the certificate's start date, the cancellation is FLAT_CANCEL effective on that start date and the whole certificate premium is credited; otherwise it is PRO_RATA_CANCEL effective on the borrower policy's effective date and the credit is the annual premium multiplied by the days from that date to the certificate expiration date divided by the days in the certificate term, rounded to the cent.
